license: Curated factual gene-set summary; source terms apply
source: Isolated DNA mismatch-repair (MMR) gene mutation proxy panel curated before model execution

input_contract.observable: Per-gene protein mutation strings supplied by the competition

mmr_deficiency_proxy.interpretation: Observed core MMR-gene variant proxy, isolated from the bundled colorectal panel used in EXP-302 (which also mixed in KRAS/NRAS/BRAF); not MSI-H or dMMR assay status

deferred_capture_items.reason: EXP-302 tested MLH1/MSH2/MSH6/PMS2 only as part of a 7-gene colorectal panel that also included non-MMR RAS/BRAF genes, so an MMR-only signal was never isolated

interpretation_limit: These features are mutation proxies for a classification experiment. They do not reproduce clinical MSI/dMMR biomarker assays, establish cancer causality, diagnose Lynch syndrome, or determine treatment eligibility.
